BEGIN
 IF (NEW.id,NEW.owner_id,NEW.faculty_id,NEW.create_operation,NEW.command_digest,NEW.content_json,NEW.content_digest,NEW.created_at)
 IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.owner_id,OLD.faculty_id,OLD.create_operation,OLD.command_digest,OLD.content_json,OLD.content_digest,OLD.created_at)
 OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1
 OR NOT ((OLD.status='DRAFT' AND NEW.status IN ('SUBMITTED','WITHDRAWN')) OR (OLD.status='SUBMITTED' AND NEW.status='WITHDRAWN'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid adjustment transition'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable adjustment history'; END
BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM faculty_adjustment_decisions WHERE request_id=OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'request already decided'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable Chair decision'; END

BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM faculty_adjustment_requests r JOIN faculty_adjustment_decisions d ON d.request_id=r.id JOIN users u ON u.id=NEW.actor_id JOIN published_schedule_versions p ON p.id=NEW.previous_version_id JOIN published_schedule_versions n ON n.id=NEW.new_version_id WHERE r.id=NEW.request_id AND r.status='SUBMITTED' AND d.id=NEW.decision_id AND d.action='APPROVE' AND d.department_id=NEW.department_id AND u.is_active AND n.previous_id=p.id AND n.schedule_key=p.schedule_key AND n.sequence=p.sequence+1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid application'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END

BEGIN IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published_schedule_versions v WHERE v.id=NEW.version_id AND v.schedule_key=NEW.schedule_key AND v.sequence=1 AND NEW.sequence=1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid initial head'; END IF; ELSE IF NEW.schedule_key<>OLD.schedule_key OR NEW.sequence<>OLD.sequence+1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published_schedule_versions v JOIN schedule_adjustment_applications a ON a.new_version_id=v.id WHERE v.id=NEW.version_id AND v.previous_id=OLD.version_id AND v.schedule_key=NEW.schedule_key AND v.sequence=NEW.sequence) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid publication transition'; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable publication history'; END

BEGIN IF NOT ((NEW.sequence=1 AND NEW.previous_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM published_schedule_versions p WHERE p.id=NEW.previous_id AND p.schedule_key=NEW.schedule_key AND p.sequence=NEW.sequence-1)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid publication lineage'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END

DECLARE r gec_records%ROWTYPE; v gec_revisions%ROWTYPE; BEGIN
      SELECT * INTO r FROM gec_records WHERE id=NEW.record_id FOR UPDATE;
      SELECT * INTO v FROM gec_revisions WHERE id=NEW.revision_id AND record_id=NEW.record_id;
      IF r.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL OR NEW.sequence <> r.version+1 OR NEW.previous_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.head_event_id
       OR (NEW.action='CONFIRM' AND v.base_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.head_event_id)
       OR (NEW.action='REVOKE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gec_events h WHERE h.id=r.head_event_id AND h.action='CONFIRM' AND h.revision_id=v.id))
      THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'stale GEC transition'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END

BEGIN
        IF (NEW.id,NEW.academic_year,NEW.term,NEW.supplier,NEW.created_at) IS DISTINCT FROM
           (OLD.id,OLD.academic_year,OLD.term,OLD.supplier,OLD.created_at) OR NEW.version <> OLD.version+1 OR
           NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gec_events e WHERE e.id=NEW.head_event_id AND e.record_id=OLD.id
             AND e.sequence=NEW.version AND e.previous_event_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.head_event_id)
        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid GEC head transition'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable GEC history'; END

BEGIN
      IF NEW.version<>0 OR NEW.head_event_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid initial GEC head'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END

BEGIN
      UPDATE gec_records SET head_event_id=NEW.id, version=NEW.sequence WHERE id=NEW.record_id; RETURN NEW; END
